native.payload_bytes: Actual logical message payload0..64 bytes unknown. Wire Data field may be padded according to DLC; actual known wire length must cover logical bytes. Nine logical bytes require at least12 wire bytes. Larger actual DLC must be counted, never silently reduced to logical length.
native.retransmission_enabled: Automatic retransmission is the CAN CC protocol baseline, proposed true only; false is invalid for this declared baseline. One-shot hardware modes need separate actual-controller behavior. No finite retry count or error-free operation is implied.
native.queue_policy: Abstract NIS host FIFO/PRIORITY/CUSTOM scenario, not CAN wire arbitration. Wire priority follows identifier and RTR/IDE ordering; host FIFO can cause priority inversion. Remove unsupported TSN shaping options from this host control.
native.can_frame_format: Actual IDE choice BASE_11/EXTENDED_29 unknown. Both formats may coexist; actual per-message field, not an industry default. Capacity bound uses longer format if IDE unknown, and never confirms an inferred identifier.
native.can_frame_type: CAN FD has DATA only, no remote-request frame. CC compatibility requires a separately identified classic frame and its own DLC/CRC/timing rules.
native.can_identifier: Actual unsigned CAN identifier unknown, not an arbitrary default priority3. BASE_11 <=2047, EXTENDED_29 <=536870911; actual collision-free assignment and base/SRR/RTR arbitration scheduling require separate verification.
native.can_controller_profile: Actual controller family unknown. M_CAN_3_3_1 explicit choice activates only that manual's prescaler/segment limits. DEVICE_SPECIFIC never inherits M_CAN register maxima or historical Bosch2.0 legacy segment maxima.
native.can_clock_hz: Actual CAN controller clock unknown in Hz, not CPU clock or universal8MHz. Complete actual functional timing tuple must satisfy bitrate=clock/[prescaler*(1+TSEG1+TSEG2)]. M_CAN reset500k at8MHz is an example, not a generic CAN rate default.
native.can_prescaler: Actual positive integer functional prescaler unknown, not zero-based hardware register. M_CAN3.3.1 allows1..512; other controllers require own datasheet limits. No universal default or maximum512 imposed without that explicit controller profile.
native.can_tseg1_tq: Actual functional Prop_Seg+Phase_Seg1 unknown. M_CAN3.3.1 functional2..256 only for explicit controller; not historical1..8 segments copied into every controller. Together with SYNC1 and TSEG2 defines bit period and sample point.
native.can_tseg2_tq: Actual functional Phase_Seg2 unknown. M_CAN3.3.1 functional2..128 only when selected. Actual oscillator/propagation/sample-point tolerances still require hardware and topology evidence.
native.can_sjw_tq: Actual functional resynchronization jump unknown, positive integer <=actual TSEG1 and TSEG2. Explicit M_CAN3.3.1 <=128; hardware zero-based register encoding is not entered as functional zero.
native.sample_point_percent: Actual end-of-TSEG1 sample point unknown, strictly between0 and100 percent. With known segments must equal100*(1+TSEG1)/(1+TSEG1+TSEG2). No CANopen87.5% or historical generic80% proposed as universal CAN standard.
native.can_error_state: Observed ERROR_ACTIVE/ERROR_PASSIVE/BUS_OFF unknown, not default healthy. Active counters<=127; passive TX<256; bus-off TX>=256. Both observed counters<=127 contradict passive state. Counter dynamics, ACK exceptions/recovery sequence are not implemented by static validation.
native.can_tx_error_count: Actual observed nonnegative integer transmit error counter unknown, not injected bit-error probability. No invented controller counter width; profile verifies known state thresholds but does not prove current fault-confinement execution.
native.can_rx_error_count: Actual observed nonnegative integer receive error counter unknown; error-active requires<=127. Controller reset/reception transition behavior must use actual implementation evidence.
native.can_ack_receiver_count: Actual count of receivers capable of acknowledging unknown. Zero is valid as an observed incomplete network, never successful communication evidence. Single transmitter without ACK repeats frames; model must not certify delivery from configured bitrate.
native.can_termination_ohms: CiA HS line topology recommendation120 Ohm at each end proposed; actual impedance/split termination and placement require wiring verification. Positive numeric input is configuration, not proof of ISO electrical conformance.
native.can_bus_length_m: Actual line length unknown and nonnegative. CiA theoretical40m at1M is not a universal validated installation limit; real cables/transceivers/sample point reduce allowable length. No automatic length derived from bitrate.
native.can_stub_length_m: Actual longest stub unknown; no CANopen rate-specific table silently reused as universal CC. Topology/propagation/electrical loading need actual line evidence.
native.arbitration_bitrate: Actual nominal CAN FD rate unknown, positive numeric bit/s <=1M. No universal500k default; topology/controller/PHY sampling determines installed rate. Shared CAN nominal clock/prescaler/segments are checked against this phase, not against data rate.
native.data_bitrate: Actual configured data-phase rate unknown, positive numeric bit/s. No universal2M default or generic8M hardware ceiling. Actual transceiver ceiling constrains it; explicit M_CAN requires >=nominal. Required for known BRS true or unresolved BRS; known false uses nominal timing and needs no second rate.
native.can_fd_revision: ISO11898-1:2015/2024 FD baseline proposed. Non-ISO pre-standard CRC/stuffing differs and is not silently accepted or simulated by this registered profile.
native.can_fd_brs: BRS false baseline proposal uses nominal bit timing throughout frame; true switches at BRS sample point and back at CRC delimiter. Actual frame bit unknown until user/device review. Unknown BRS uses slower whole-frame rate for conservative estimates, never silently enables fast data phase.
native.can_fd_dlc: Actual integer encoded DLC0..15 unknown. Maps to wire bytes0..8,12,16,20,24,32,48,64. This code differs from logical payload and classic DLC; known mismatching code/wire length is rejected.
native.can_fd_wire_data_bytes: Actual complete CAN FD Data field including padding unknown, restricted to DLC lengths0..8/12/16/20/24/32/48/64. Registry/capacity/frame/schedule consumers use actual declared padding; no full64-byte default.
native.can_fd_error_passive: Actual ESI indicator unknown boolean; false error-active and true error-passive. Known controller state and ESI must agree. Static check does not implement fault-confinement transitions or establish healthy bus.
native.can_fd_crc_bits: ISO CRC sequence17 bits for actual wire data<=16 bytes,21 for>16. Unknown until actual wire length known. Not CRC field total length: SBC/parity/fixed stuffing add bits. Conservative frame budget reserves these without claiming bit-exact CRC execution.
native.can_fd_transceiver_max_bps: Actual selected transceiver data-phase limit unknown, positive numeric integer configuration. CiA states limit depends on transceiver characteristics; no universal8M or CAN XL20M bound imported. Actual topology/sample-point/loop-delay evidence remains required.
native.can_fd_data_prescaler: Actual functional data prescaler unknown, not raw zero-based register. Explicit M_CAN3.3.1 allows1..32; with TDC enabled only1..2. Other controller families need their own profile and limits.
native.can_fd_data_tseg1_tq: Actual functional data Prop_Seg+Phase_Seg1 unknown. M_CAN3.3.1 allows1..32. Distinct from nominal TSEG1 and its2..256 M_CAN limit. Complete tuple verifies data rate and sample point.
native.can_fd_data_tseg2_tq: Actual functional data Phase_Seg2 unknown. Explicit M_CAN3.3.1 allows2..16; not nominal2..128. Unknown other controller limits are not manufactured.
native.can_fd_data_sjw_tq: Actual functional data resynchronization jump unknown, positive <=actual dataTSEG1/TSEG2. Explicit M_CAN3.3.1 <=16, separate from nominalSJW<=128.
native.can_fd_data_sample_point_percent: Actual data sample point unknown, strictly0..100 percent; known segments require100*(1+dataTSEG1)/(1+dataTSEG1+dataTSEG2). No universal80% default or nominal87.5% copied to data phase.
native.can_fd_tdc_enabled: Actual transmitter delay compensation state unknown; no generic checkbox false confirmation. M_CAN hardware constraint/data prescaler limits apply only with explicit controller and known enabled condition.
native.can_fd_mcan_delay_mtq: Actual M_CAN measured transmit-to-receive delay unknown in minimum clock quanta,0..127 representable. Hardware continually measures delay for FD with TDC; this is not a universal static delay default.
native.can_fd_mcan_tdco_mtq: Actual explicit M_CAN offset unknown,0..127 minimum clock quanta. Adds to measured delay for secondary sample position; not ordinary data sampling percentage.
native.can_fd_mcan_tdcf_mtq: Actual M_CAN filter window unknown,0..127mtq. Feature effective when TDCF>TDCO; smaller configured value may validly disable filter and is not forced to an invented relation.
native.can_fd_mcan_ssp_mtq: Actual M_CAN secondary sample position unknown, equals measured delay+TDCO when all supplied. <=127mtq and with TDC enabled strictly less than6 data bit times. Saturation is not accepted as proof that intended sample position remains within hardware bound.

removed.qos_priority: Ethernet PCP0..7 is not CAN identifier priority.
removed.sync_method: CAN bit synchronization is not NTP/PTP/gPTP clock synchronization.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: No universal CAN bandwidth reservation percentage.
removed.retransmission_rate: Scenario probability does not implement CAN ACK/error/fault-confinement retry behavior.
removed.retry_limit: No universal zero-retry limit; protocol automatic retransmission and hardware mode differ.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: CAN bus-idle/error/intermission rules are not generic zero-millisecond retry delay.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: No verified generic CAN gateway throughput100 Mbit/s.

scope: Every registered ISO CAN FD form field, DLC/body/wire/CRC/ESI, independent nominal/data controller timing and optional BRS. Conservative successful-frame phase envelope, DLC padding and registered timing/load consumers plus SQL persistence. Type/default/constraint verification is distinct from actual hardware, bit-exact protocol execution and capacity assurance.

validation.suite: full_parameter_audit + standard_defaults + profile_semantics + capacity_can_schedule + parameter_review + required_parameters

not_certified: Bit-exact ISO CRC/SBC/dynamic and fixed stuffing encoding
Non-ISO CAN FD, CAN FD light, CAN XL or industry-specific higher layers
Actual TDC measurement or fault-inclusive finite retransmission schedule
Installed mixed CC/FD compatibility and complete functional E2E acceptance
